package.name: freenove_driver
package.description: Thin ROS 2 package wrapping the Freenove 4WD Smart Car Kit's hardware driver modules (motor, PCA9685, ultrasonic, servo) so ROS 2 nodes can import them directly. The four driver .py files are fetched by etw3-setup/setup.sh, not committed here — see NOTICE.md once vendored.
